Bring softness, comfort, and timeless style to your bathroom with the Better Trends Lux Collection Reversible Bath Rug. Crafted from 100% cotton with a plush tufted weave construction, this 2370 GSM absorbent bath rug delivers a soft, cushioned feel underfoot while helping keep bathroom floors dry and comfortable. Designed with a classic solid pattern and reversible construction, the Lux Bath Rug combines everyday functionality with elevated style. Featuring a pile height of approximately 10 mm (0.39 in.) and a mat thickness of approximately 15 mm (0.59 in.), it provides a plush and comfortable feel while adding warmth and texture to your bathroom. Its highly absorbent cotton fibers quickly soak up moisture around showers, bathtubs, sinks, and vanities, while the quick-drying design helps maintain a fresh and comfortable bathroom environment. Perfect for modern, traditional, farmhouse, and contemporary decor styles, this versatile bathroom rug adds warmth, texture, and everyday luxury to any space. The reversible design allows for extended use and lasting durability, making it a practical addition to busy households. Available in multiple colors and sizes, the Lux Collection easily complements a variety of bathroom layouts and decorating styles. Machine washable for easy care, this soft cotton bath rug is designed to maintain its plush texture, absorbency, and beautiful appearance wash after wash. OEKO-TEX Certified and tested for harmful substances, the Better Trends Lux Bath Rug offers a safer choice for your home while delivering the perfect combination of comfort, durability, and everyday luxury. Disclaimer: This reversible bath rug does not feature a non-slip backing. For enhanced safety and stability, we recommend using a rug pad underneath.

With screen-accurate details and an easy-on design, it’s perfect for costume parties, cosplay events, or everyday superhero play. Get ready to join the DC League of Super-Pets and protect the city—one mission at a time!
